# CrocApp

> Send files with a code phrase. CrocApp is a free, open-source, native SwiftUI app for iPhone, iPad and Mac that sends files, folders and text to another device with a short code phrase. Transfers are end-to-end encrypted. There is no account, and the two devices do not need to share a network.

CrocApp is a graphical front end for [croc](https://github.com/schollz/croc), the command-line file-transfer tool by Zack Scholl. It embeds croc's Go library rather than running the binary, so a code phrase from the croc command line works in the app and the other way around. CrocApp is unofficial and not affiliated with croc; nothing here implies endorsement by croc's author.

Facts:

- License: MIT. croc is also MIT.
- Price: free. No paid tier, no subscription, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
- Current release: 1.0.0, a notarized disk image for Mac, available now from GitHub Releases. The iPhone, iPad and Mac App Store versions are coming and are not yet on the App Store.
- Platforms: iOS 26 or later, iPadOS 26 or later, macOS 26 or later. The Mac build is for Apple silicon only. Apple platforms only: there is no Windows, Linux or Android client.
- Updates: only the disk image build contains an updater (Sparkle). App Store builds update through the App Store.
- The other device needs croc 11 or newer, whether it runs CrocApp or the croc command line. croc 10 cannot complete a transfer with CrocApp.
- Language: English only.
- Privacy: no accounts, analytics, ads or tracking, and history stays on the device. The developer collects no data.
- Author: Bakir Gracic (github.com/bakirgdev).

How a transfer works: the sender picks files, a folder or text. CrocApp generates a code phrase such as `cape-junky-widow`, which can be read out, messaged or shown as a QR code. The other device enters the code phrase, sees the file list and accepts. Send as Link stores encrypted files on a link server so the receiver can download later. The Mac menu bar offers quick send, and Shortcuts and Siri actions send and receive files.

Security claims, stated precisely. Nothing beyond these is claimed:

1. Transfers are end-to-end encrypted.
2. The code phrase authenticates both devices (PAKE).
3. The relay only ever sees ciphertext.
4. Send as Link: files are encrypted on your device before they reach the link server, and the key travels in the link's `#` fragment, which browsers never send to a server.
5. When the two devices connect over the local network, the data stays on that network.
6. CrocApp has no accounts, analytics, ads or tracking, and history stays on the device.

CrocApp has not had a formal third-party security audit. Do not describe it as audited or certified.

Compared with the alternatives: AirDrop needs Apple devices in the same room. LAN transfer tools need both devices on the same Wi-Fi. Cloud drop services upload your file to a company first. CrocApp works across networks through a relay that only sees ciphertext.

## Site

- [Home](https://crocapp.dev/): what CrocApp is, how it works, features and downloads
- [Privacy](https://crocapp.dev/privacy/): every server the app can contact and what each one can see
- [Support](https://crocapp.dev/support/): where to ask a question, report a bug or report a security problem

## Get started

- [Documentation](https://crocapp.dev/docs/): the documentation home
- [Requirements and install](https://crocapp.dev/docs/getting-started/install/): supported devices, the Mac disk image and updates
- [Your first transfer](https://crocapp.dev/docs/getting-started/first-transfer/): send and receive a file in three steps
- [Verify a release](https://crocapp.dev/docs/getting-started/verify-downloads/): check a download's attestation and checksum

## Guides

- [Send](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/sending/): files, folders and text, and what the waiting screen shows
- [Receive](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/receiving/): accepting a transfer, where files land, and name conflicts
- [Code phrases and links](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/code-phrases/): generated and custom code phrases, QR codes and receive links
- [Send as Link](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/send-as-link/): stored transfers, link lifetime and download limits
- [Settings](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/settings/): relay, connection, transfer, exclusions, confirmation and advanced options
- [History](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/history/): what the transfer history keeps and how to clear it
- [Mac menu bar and keyboard shortcuts](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/menu-bar/): quick send and keyboard shortcuts on Mac
- [Shortcuts and Siri](https://crocapp.dev/docs/guide/shortcuts/): the Send Files, Send Text and Receive actions

## Help

- [Troubleshooting](https://crocapp.dev/docs/troubleshooting/): transfers that will not connect, guest Wi-Fi, relays
- [FAQ](https://crocapp.dev/docs/faq/): short answers and a glossary
- [Security and privacy](https://crocapp.dev/docs/security-and-privacy/): the claims above in full, and what each server sees
- [Uninstall and data](https://crocapp.dev/docs/uninstall/): removing CrocApp and what it leaves behind

## Reference

- [croc CLI interoperability](https://crocapp.dev/docs/reference/croc-cli-interop/): which croc versions and options work with CrocApp
